dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Rapid, symmetrical linear narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior point, creating a teardrop-shaped 2D profile.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey/off-white median intensity across the visible dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey clusters localized primarily in the posterior third of the visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; gradual gradient transitions between light grey baseline and darker mottled regions.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent longitudinal high-reflectance line indicating the dorsal ridge along the anterior-central axis.
